label: Ordered Pairs
subgoals: The direct product consists of pairs with coordinatewise multiplication.
The identity is the pair of identities, and inverses are taken coordinate by coordinate.

label: Element Orders
subgoals: The order of a pair is the least common multiple of the coordinate orders.
The exponent of the product is the least common multiple of the factor exponents.

label: When the Product Is Cyclic
subgoals: A product of two cyclic groups is cyclic exactly when the orders are coprime.
The Chinese remainder theorem is the classical number-theoretic case.
